title: Repeated IID extraction pattern across compress functions
description:
## Location
`rust/lichen-schc/src/codec.rs` lines 405-406, 474-475, 520-521, 568-569, 632-633

## Issue
The pattern `u64::from_be_bytes(src[8..16].try_into().unwrap())` appears 6 times for extracting 64-bit IIDs from IPv6 addresses.

## Current code
```rust
let src_iid = u64::from_be_bytes(src[8..16].try_into().unwrap());
let dst_iid = u64::from_be_bytes(dst[8..16].try_into().unwrap());
```

## Suggested fix
Add a helper function:

```rust
#[inline]
fn iid_from_addr(addr: &[u8]) -> u64 {
    u64::from_be_bytes(addr[8..16].try_into().unwrap())
}
```

Then: `let src_iid = iid_from_addr(src);`

## Impact
Minor DRY improvement. The unwrap is safe (slices are always 16 bytes from IPv6 header extraction), but extracting it makes the intent clearer.
